learning_outcomes.text: Update fundamental knowledge on topics related to the control of mechatronic applications.
Use mathematical tools that allow them to analyze and solve mechatronic applications.
Combine classical control concepts with modern control theories.
Analyze the characteristics of multivariable dynamic systems from their mathematical description.

syllabus_topics: Control and Simulation of Dynamic Systems

assessment_methods.method: Control and Simulation of Dynamic Systems (CTRL) grade
Synthesis and Simulation of Mechanisms (SSM) grade
Development of a Mechatronic Prototype (PROY) grade

assessment_rules: To pass "Automatic Control II", students must pass the three local Master's subjects. The final grade is calculated as 0.6 * CTRL + 0.2 * SSM + 0.2 * PROY. If any of the three local courses are not passed, the final grade will be FAIL, and the numerical grade will be the weighted average or 4.0 (whichever is lower). If a student does not take all local subject exams, their final grade will be "Not Presented" (NP) or FAIL depending on the number of exams taken, with participation in at least 50% of activities obliging a grade.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
degree: Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica
